motives.ai: 70. The gap: framing.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But other sites can frame the page.

What to change: Send frame-ancestors 'self' in the CSP, or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, so other sites cannot frame your pages.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.

What to change: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
